newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's Kirin Brewery to cut ad budget - Nikkei.
newsitem.headline: Japan's Kirin Brewery to cut ad budget - Nikkei.

text.p: Kirin Brewery Co. will hold advertising costs down to 27.8 billion yen ($220.5 million) for the period ending December 1997, a 16-percent reduction over the previous period, Nikkei news service reported on Friday.
It said Asahi Breweries Ltd was pushing hard to overtake Kirin in beer sales, but sluggish sales had led Kirin to place priority on maintaining profits by keeping costs down.
Despite an increased advertising budget last period, sales of Kirin's draft lager were squeezed by Asahi's Super Dry beer, and draft lager sales dropped by almost 4.0 percent, Nikkei said.
With a current-period 2.0-percent increase in sales and lowered advertising costs, however, ordinary profits are projected to increase 19 percent to 63 billion yen. ($ = 126.1 Japanese Yen)
